assessments.reasoning: The DuckDB project's friendly-SQL section on physical page 776 documents the standalone FROM tbl form as selecting all columns. The clause documentation on physical page 512 also illustrates the equivalence within the same manual.

challenge.method: Compared the bare single-table form and SELECT * FROM tbl example on physical page 512 with the separate column modifiers mentioned on page 776 and file-loading forms mentioned on page 777.
challenge.results: The bare-table example declares the two forms equivalent and displays both columns. The separate variants add syntax outside the scope of this claim.

limitations: The result covers the manual's standalone FROM followed by one table name. It concerns projection, with row ordering and other FROM forms governed separately.
